queue-audit-residue-miscited-as-preexist.reason: Re-read the bullet at 9c03a19a7480548cac5aad7fa9fa53405cb2fe2c. It now retracts the earlier claim in terms, says plainly that it was wrong for three of the five, gives the per-row table (Crate 1431 to 1427, Coin 1148 to 1147, daGmch_c 1119 to 1120) with each row delta matched to its source-file line delta, and keeps only ChiefChilly and Player as pre-existing -- which the base control independently confirms are exactly the two rows main is red on. ONE RESIDUAL IMPRECISION, settled here as clearing without a new finding. The bullet attributes the ChiefChilly/Player staleness to main's 9b8cb8add editing include/ChiefChilly.h and include/Player.h. That is the wrong half of the commit: queue_audit derives total_lines by summing lines over the delinks-resolved source paths of the row's range, which are src/ paths only, and no include/ path appears in config/arm9/delinks.txt, so a header edit cannot move the cell. The same commit 9b8cb8add also edited src/_ZN11ChiefChillyD1Ev.cpp and src/_ZN6PlayerD1Ev.cpp, and those are what moved the numbers: measured with git show 9b8cb8add^:<path> piped to wc -l against git show 9b8cb8add:<path>, 22 to 23 and 35 to 36, which are exactly the +1 deltas the two rows need. The commit attribution and the direction of responsibility are therefore both correct and independently verified; 9b8cb8add is an ancestor of both bdcb1df7d and the branch's merge-base c52f63ca5, so it is genuinely main's. Only the named mechanism is wrong. It moves no number, changes no gate verdict and does not affect this branch's attribution, and under source_review a provenance finding may not be deferred, so raising it would require a corrective commit that mode verify forbids -- converting a wrong noun into a hard publish refusal. It clears as-is and is recorded here so the next writer touching this bullet fixes the sentence. Disposition unchanged: fixed.
